claims.claim: arena config, prompt configs and tool files are schema-validated on load; arena config requires providers and defaults
packc compile flags: -c/--config (default config.arena.yaml), -o/--output (default <id>.pack.json), --id (default current folder name sanitized), --pack-version (default v1.0.0)
packc compile and compile-prompt both create the output directory (writePackFile)
compile prints '✓ Pack compiled successfully' with prompts (listed by task type), tools, eval, workflow and agent counts
packc inspect prints pack info, prompts, tools, fragments, evals, skills, workflow, compositions, agents, metadata, compilation
default id from current directory name via SanitizePackID; non-letter start gets pack- prefix
pack id pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$; invalid --id rejected before compile with [pack_id] error
packc compile sets name=id, version from --pack-version (default v1.0.0), description 'Pack containing N prompts', $schema latest URL, compilation block
packc compile-prompt flags -p/--prompt and -o/--output, both required; --pack-version optional
compile-prompt: id from task type (_ to -), name/description from prompt, version from spec.version or --pack-version, $schema set
compile prints warnings as '⚠ [stage] message' and fails with 'Compilation failed:'
missing config/prompt and YAML errors are reported under [load] with 'loading arena config:'
templates are not parsed; only check is variables declared when template contains {{ (error names the prompt by task type)
missing media example files warn 'media(<task>): Media file not found: ...' relative to config dir (compile) or prompt dir (compile-prompt)
compile-prompt creates the output directory; write errors print 'Failed to write pack file: ...'
validate prints 'Validating pack', '✓ Schema validation passed', warnings, '✓ Pack structure is valid'; errors exit 1
